body:
Adds `research/quantized-reports`: regret of reporting probabilities from a finite grid under Brier/log scores. It includes an optimal-grid regret law (matched to 0.3%), a ln N loss for uniform grids under log score, and a comparison of raw versus symmetrised minifloat formats. Stdlib Python, 7 tests, white paper, README and portfolio entries.
